title: SaathiOS private-alpha product contract

admitted.description: The single human who owns this SaathiOS installation. Bootstrapped once via bootstrap_owner_secure. Holds owner-required approval authority.
admitted.provisioning: platform bootstrap (first run), one per installation

admitted.description: A person the owner has explicitly provisioned into an organization and workspace with an operator role. May create and run allowed missions.
admitted.provisioning: owner-issued invite or owner-performed provisioning only

admitted.description: A specifically invited external tester, scoped to one organization and one workspace, typically with viewer or operator role.
admitted.provisioning: owner-issued invite only; invite is single-use and bound to an email

excluded: any identity not explicitly provisioned by the owner

public_self_registration.may_be_enabled_later: only by an explicit, separately authorized milestone; never by automation and never as a side effect of this milestone

audience.max_concurrent_testers_supported: bounded by the single-host 8 GB reference machine; see M341 soak and concurrency evidence

environment.network_posture: localhost-only (127.0.0.1 backend on 8765, localhost frontend on 3000)
environment.public_binding: prohibited — no 0.0.0.0 bind, no tunnel, no ngrok, no DNS record
environment.deployment: local or an explicitly owner-approved private environment; no public deployment
environment.provider_calls: mock providers, replay fixtures and local deterministic tools only; REAL_CONNECTIVITY_AUTHORIZED=false
environment.external_tools: no unrestricted tool execution; every tool runs through the ExecutionGateway with the registered-tool authority boundary
environment.credentials: no real trading, broker or paid-provider credentials are requested, accepted or stored
environment.data_location: data/platform/platform.db and data/alpha/* on the operator's own machine; nothing leaves the host

steps.name: user_authenticates
steps.surface: platform sign-in; invalid credentials fail closed

steps.name: authorized_human_approves_or_rejects
steps.authority: human actor only; the LLM may never approve

explicitly_unsupported: paper execution through an external provider
claims of general autonomy without limits
cloud backup, cloud monitoring or external telemetry
paid AI provider activation during first run

may: explain why an approval is needed

ui_disclosure_requirements.platform_status_wording: Local platform status must never read as broker connectivity, live market access, account connection, execution readiness or live trading. Global connectivity labels are corrected in M340.
